description:
Today, I was dumped by Kim Yeo-Hee again. Countless confessions, countless rejections. This is love, it was too horrible.

 *“You’ve become a fool while Je-Gyeom wasn’t looking?”
“…That’s okay. Just go home and adjust to the time difference.”* 

I was already miserable, but Baek Hyun-Oh, who had suddenly returned from the US, started to tease me with ridiculous words.

 *“Hey, what would you do if I seduced her?”
“I couldn’t do it, so how could you?”
“I’ll do it. I’m not a fool like some people.”* 

It was a crappy bet. But why? It was funny, but my heart wavered dangerously at Baek Hyun-Oh’s teasing. I shouldn’t have done this, but I wanted to know Kim Yeo-Hee’s true feelings.

 *“Just give me three months. I’ll get Kim Yeo-Hee’s button.”*

It was the beginning of a dangerous bet.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
